Electricity Bill Estimator calculates your monthly electricity bill using the block tariff rates, applies a rebate of 0% – 5%, and saves every result in an offline (SQLite) database so you can review, edit or delete it later.

1. On the main screen, choose the month (January – December) from the drop-down list.
2. Enter the electricity units used in kWh (minimum 1, maximum 1000). An error is shown if the value is empty or out of range.
3. Drag the slider to set the rebate percentage (0% – 5%).
4. Tap "Calculate & Save". The Total Charges and Final Cost after rebate appear on the same screen and the record is saved to the local database.
5. Tap "Clear" to reset the form.
6. Tap "View Saved Bills" to see the list of saved bills (month and final cost).
7. Tap any bill in the list to open its details (month, units, total charges, rebate and final cost).
8. On the details page, tap "Edit" to change the month, units or rebate, then "Save Changes". Tap "Delete" to remove the bill.

Tariff blocks:
• First 200 kWh (1–200): 21.8 sen/kWh
• Next 100 kWh (201–300): 33.4 sen/kWh
• Next 300 kWh (301–600): 51.6 sen/kWh
• Next 400 kWh (601–1000): 54.6 sen/kWh

Final cost = Total charges − (Total charges × rebate %)
